steps.name: Clicking on seller choose field
Enter seller name
Selecting desired Seller
Clicking on Menu Tab seller
Clicking on Campaigns Tab seller
Navigate to In-Store Digital Page
Clicking on create campaign button
Renaming of campaign name
Click on the Date Range Selector
Click on the Date Range Selector
Click on the Date Range Selector
Select Date Range from dual month calendar
Clicking on the exact day
Clicking on the exact day
Select Time Slot 4 hours ahead of current time
Select Individual Screen Selection Radio Button
Click on Select Screen Button
Enter Screen Name in Search Field
Click on Individual Screen Refresh Button
Clicking on pop up close button
Click on Individual Screen Menu Button
Click on Screen Details View Button
Verify Screen Details Wrapper is Displayed
Click on Page Close Button
Select desired screen by checkboxes
Click on Add Screens Button
Click on Calculate Metrics Button
Get Side Panel Card Value
Get Side Panel Card Value
Get Side Panel Card Value
Get Side Panel Card Value
Click on Next Step Button
Click on New Ad Button
Enter the ad Name
Upload In-Store Digital Ad Image
Click on Ad Save Button
Click on Second Ad Format Tab
Click on New Ad Button
Enter the ad Name
Upload In-Store Digital Ad Video
Click on Ad Save Button
Click on Next Step Button
Click on Pay Now and Send for Review Button
Check if Plays to Book Field Error Message is Displayed
Clicking on pop up close button
Enter Plays to Book on Configuration Page
Click on Pay Now and Send for Review Button
Check if Plays to Book Field Error Message is Displayed
Clicking on pop up close button
Enter Plays to Book on Configuration Page
Validate that plays to book field does not accepts more than 100%
Get Total Available PlayHours in percentage
Enter Plays to Book on Configuration Page
Click on Pay Now and Send for Review Button
Verify Payment Page is Displayed
Clicking on cross button to close the page in level 2
Click on Plays to Book Type Dropdown
Select desired Plays to Book Type Option
Enter Plays to Book on Configuration Page
Check if Plays to Book Field Error Message is Displayed
Enter Plays to Book on Configuration Page
Click on Pay Now and Send for Review Button
Check if Plays to Book Field Error Message is Displayed
Clicking on pop up close button
Get Total Available PlayHours
Enter Plays to Book on Configuration Page
Click on Pay Now and Send for Review Button
Check if Plays to Book Field Error Message is Displayed
Clicking on pop up close button
Enter Plays to Book on Configuration Page
Click on Pay Now and Send for Review Button
Click on Pay from Wallet Balance Button
